title: Threat register (threat-model@2)
description: The machine form of docs/core/threat-model.md: one row per threat on an agent surface, with the control and the evidence behind it. scripts/check_threat_model_spec.py implements the rules this schema cannot express (a control that names a path must name one that exists; a surface with no rows is a gap) and must agree with this file.

reviewed.description: ISO date of the last review. The register is reviewed quarterly or after a Sev1.

surfaces.description: The surfaces this register must cover. A surface with no row is a gap, not a quiet quarter.

accepted.description: Threats accepted rather than controlled — each with who accepted it and why.

stride.description: One letter: spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, denial, elevation.

status.description: `open` has no control and blocks the gate; `planned` names the issue that will build it; `accepted` needs a justification in `accepted`.

path.description: A file in the repository that holds the control or its proof. A path that does not exist is a wish.
